paragraphs: Van Dyk Recycling Solutions consults on and sells equipment to recyclers and waste processors. Its systems handle the sorting of single stream, commercial waste, construction and demolition debris, plastics, e-waste and municipal solid waste.

The company sells a complete turnkey package that includes design, installation, training and lifetime service and support. Its engineers study a customer's business and recommend equipment and systems suited to that facility. Product lines shown on the site include Bollegraaf two-ram balers. The site also lists Multi-MRF material recycling facility systems.

The company states that it has over 340 MRFs and 2,400 recycling and sorting systems installed in the North American market to date. Support offerings listed include remote maintenance and troubleshooting. The home page also advertises free telephone support. Training on the installation and repair of its products is offered. A technology and material test center carries the company name. Its listed address is on Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Drive in Norwalk, Connecticut.
